build.native: Both Rust SDKs use Bazel -c opt and SDK-scoped cross-crate ThinLTO; both C++ consumers Release -O3.
build.comparator: Pinned upstream release, opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. Bootstrap/workloads compiled with Hermes -O.
build.clock: Same high-resolution steady_clock __now() hook; full TS suite also uses __now().

benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-all-api.hbc
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case boundary /tmp/hermes-list-arguments-control.js
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case plural /tmp/hermes-plural-record-control.js
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case first-use /tmp/hermes-list-join-first-use-control.js
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
sdk=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-list-arguments-hires
host=/tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires
for smoke in "$sdk"/js/*-smoke.js; do
 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
"$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-extension-sdk-check.js > /tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-sdk-extension-check.json
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires; fi
 taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-cold-$variant.cpuprofile" /tmp/hermes-list-join-cold-profile.js > "/tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-cold-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1
 taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-$variant.cpuprofile" /tmp/hermes-list-join-profile.js > "/tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-list-join-reused-run.sh
order: Three rounds per workload; round 2 reverses host order. No builds, hooks or profiling during final timings. Profiles run first. Frozen optimized bytecode shared by every applicable host; boundary and plural source controls remain diagnostic.
change: Rust authorizes forward, context-free templates with equal start/middle separators. For 5–127 strings, first call remains native and lookup waits for reuse; at least 128 strings can repay plan lookup immediately. A private symbol on the opaque handle stores the immutable plan, null or first-call sentinel, avoiding a second WeakMap and its collection cost. Captured join concatenates only fully validated strings; other patterns and every parts call retain Rust formatting. Existing instances preserve selected data across registration. No C++ or C ABI changes.
conformance: 3,168 shared ListFormat cases across 11 locales and all styles/types, checked by ICU4C/J and Hermes. ICU4X independently checks 3,069 scalar cases; 69 exact output differences pinned, including three new Hebrew hyphen cases where C/J agree. Another 99 lone-surrogate cases remain C/J/Hermes-only. Twelve focused gates also cover ListFormat test262, DurationFormat source/package/test262 and Rust unit/FFI tests and the all-CLDR Rust/TS corpus, now batched to bound subprocess output. Iterator getter/close order, custom/reversed/contextual fallback, intrinsic tampering, data replacement and 127/128/129 plus 1,024/1,025-element boundaries tested. Every shared-oracle formatter checks initial and reused calls.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-list-join-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi

 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
"$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-extension-sdk-check.js > /tmp/hermes-list-join-sdk-extension-check.json
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-list-arguments-hires; fi
 taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-list-join-$variant.cpuprofile" /tmp/hermes-list-join-profile.js > "/tmp/hermes-list-join-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1

done
bash /tmp/hermes-list-join-run.sh
